pr_title: backupccl: move ImportRequest logic to restore processor
pr_body:
Previously, we would issue a KV level import request when processing a
RestoreSpanEntry. This would include downloading the file, re-keying and
adding to the SSTBatcher. None of these ops rely on the node they are
actually being run on, but rather operate on args passed by the restore
processor.

This change eliminates the ImportRequest and moves all that logic to the
restore processor itself. We can no longer rely on ImportResponse as a
store filter to control RESTORE jobs, so this change adds another
testing knob which achieves the same behavior.

Fixes: #57060
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/57195)

issue_context.title: backupccl: download and rekey in Restore processor
issue_context.body:
The Restore processor currently sends ImportRequests which instruct a range to download SSTs from the specified URI, merge them and re-key them with the specified re-key map, and then send the produced data as an SST with AddSSTable. The entirety of this operation is specified by its arguments -- no part of it actually uses the replica that is asked to run it.

Thus this work could trivially be moved to be done in the Restore processor itself, so that it just fetches data and produces SSTables to send with AddSStable itself, eliminating the pure-computation ImportRequest KV command entirely.

review_comments:
Nice! Do we have any other import requests? I think we can remove it in a follow up PR right? I'm not sure if there's a clean way to lift all of the `ImportRequest` protos out from the KV layer though (e.g. `ImportRequest_File`)?

I also think that we have a lot of comments that reference "ImportRequests", I think it makes sense to tidy those up in this PR rather than a follow up?
